messages:
mira (design): Dropping a lightweight proposal: a 'role quick-action' pill next to the Add button on Org > Members. Idea: pick role first (Viewer/Editor/Admin) then click Add to open invite drawer with role prefilled. reduces friction for single-member adds. mock in figma: https://figma.com/file/abc123
devon (pm): Love the reduction in steps. How does this interact with the existing roles matrix? we still need the matrix for bulk and granular perms.
arpit (frontend): plan: pill toggles a query param (/invite?role=editor), drawer reads it and sets selected role. fallback to default Viewer. keyboard: pill must be tabbable and space/enter activate.
tess (a11y): Accessibility notes: pill should use role="radio" in a radiogroup or a button with aria-pressed. whichever we pick, ensure group/labeling: aria-label="Quick invite role" and visible focus.
mira (design): I'd prefer the button group visual; aria-pressed makes sense and maps to the visual state. Also adding microcopy under the pill: "Quick add as: Editor" only for first-time org admins.
devon (pm): SSO nuance: for orgs with enforced SSO, we need to surface that earlier. Instead of a modal blocking flow, can we show a small inline row in drawer: lock icon + "SSO required for this org" and a link "How this affects invites"?
arpit (frontend): yes. implement as a notice inside the drawer header. will set role="status" for the message and make the docs link open in new tab. also will add server-side flag so external emails show a gentle validation message.
tess (a11y): role="status" announces on open but if the enforcement state changes dynamically we should use role="alert". docs link must be descriptive: "Learn how SSO affects invite acceptance".
mira (design): Another ask: add an inline audit jump: tiny link "See recent role changes" in the roles header. opens /settings/audit?event=role_change&period=30d. On hover show a 3-item preview card (actor + action + relative time) anonymized by default.
devon (pm): Permission check: non-admins shouldn't see full audit. If they click and lack permission, show inline tooltip with CTA: "Request audit access" that opens support flow. don't let them land on a blank page.
arpit (frontend): I'll gate client-side and server will enforce masking. preview card will be aria-hidden until hovered/focused and keyboard reveal will move focus into the card. no focus trap.
tess (a11y): Preview card must be announced as a list: use <ul> with <li> entries narrated like "Admin changed role for user@•••.example, 2 days ago". include a visible "Show details" button for screen readers to expand.
ops-bot: staging build deployed: https://staging.redwood.tools/role-quick/2334 build#5012 (includes keyboard + aria props)
arpit (frontend): Found two issues in staging: 1) NVDA reads the pill twice on open (heading + aria-label duplication). 2) preview card isn't closed on Esc. will fix.
mira (design): Thanks — will adjust DOM to remove duplicate accessible names and add close on Esc for the preview. Also preparing two header copy variants for a small experiment: "Add a teammate" vs "Invite someone".
devon (pm): Timeline: can we get a QAable branch by Wednesday? prioritize keyboard & screen reader flows and SSO messaging. Tess will run pass once ready.
tess (a11y): Happy to. I'll prepare a short checklist (focus order, ARIA roles, live region messages, contrast) and run NVDA/VoiceOver passes when branch is up. report back here.
mira (design): Thanks team. I'll update figma with the aria notes and anonymized preview copy. post the preview link here when ready. :sparkles:
